marketing_description: The DeWALT MAX Atomic Compact Series DCK225D2 combo kit includes two 20 V tools powered by a brushless motor and a 5 Ah lithium-ion battery. Built with a nylon, aluminum, and steel construction, this 2-tool kit features a compact design, a 1/4 in compact impact driver, a high-torque motor, an LED light, a 2-speed transmission, a keyless chuck, and overload protection.
